_comment: Aichi's average scheduled monthly earnings (所定内給与額, 千円) from the Basic Survey on Wage Structure (賃金構造基本統計調査), annual. Tables are found by title; in every other dimension the 'total' category (男女計, 年齢計, 産業計, 企業規模計...) is used. The survey changed its estimation method in 2020, so 2019 and 2020 are not strictly comparable.
name_ja: 愛知県の平均賃金(所定内給与額)

breakdowns._comment: Pay by industry and by job, per prefecture, written to docs/data/wages/ (one file per prefecture, plus catalog.json). 'vary' names an entry of the dimension that is broken down; every other dimension uses its total. English names are in fetch/wage_labels.json.
